steps.description: Collect returned books from the drop-off bin.
Scan each book barcode to check it in.
Inspect books for damage and flag issues.
Update the book status in the library system.
Place checked-in books on the reshelving cart.
Unbox new acquisitions from the delivery.
Verify items against the purchase order.
Enter book details into the library database.
Assign call numbers based on classification system.
Attach barcode labels and spine stickers.
